ITEM 1 | Two triangular wedges of flatbread-like dough, golden tan edges with bubbly browned spots, topped with melted pale-yellow cheese and scattered orange-red sauce spots; sits on left/center of plate, wedges about 12 cm long and 1 cm thick, slightly glossy from cheese | 120
ITEM 2 | Shredded white-tan meat in loose fibrous strands, pale beige with light brown edges, moist and slightly fibrous, piled in a mound about 9 cm by 6 cm and roughly 2 cm high, mixed with a few small cubes of pale off-white firm pieces | 110
ITEM 3 | Small pale off-white cubes, about 1 cm each, firm and slightly crumbly, scattered at the top-left edge of the mound near the cheese wedges | 15
ITEM 4 | Fine shredded orange carrot strands, bright orange, matte and slightly moist, forming a dense heap about 8 cm by 7 cm and roughly 2.5 cm high on the right side of the plate | 60
ITEM 5 | Sliced bell pepper pieces in red and green, glossy with thin strips about 5 cm long and 1 cm wide, arranged in a fan at upper right next to the carrots, slightly wilted with a juicy sheen | 50
ITEM 6 | Chunks of pale yellow pineapple, cut into irregular triangular pieces about 3 cm across, slightly glossy and juicy, clustered at lower right edge of the plate | 40
